environment.transport: Authenticated loopback TCP from an owned Xvfb source to a native Wayland JPEG viewer

primary_readback.method: Active virtio DRM primary plane GETFB2, fenced VirGL host transfer and PRIME RGB sampling

environment.validation_boundary: Virtual outputs, compositor screencopy, guest primary framebuffer readback and independently matched guest kernel DRM completions. Actual physical scanout and input-to-light timing remain unmeasured.
